title: Parsley Health conditions carousel
description: A light serif title with a sage pill and two round arrow buttons on the left, and a row of clover-outlined cards (16px corners) that runs off the right edge of the window: a round thumbnail, a medium forest title, a grey list of symptoms and an underlined link with an arrow at the foot. The track scrolls by one card per arrow press and snaps; on hover a card's outline darkens and its thumbnail grows 5%. On phones the title centres above the track and the arrows sit beside the pill below it.
notes: needs JavaScript for the arrows (hydrate: visible); the track still scrolls by touch or trackpad without it
thumbnails are 90px round slots; empty, a soft placeholder stands in
name: parsleyhealth-conditions
